title: Supported-source transport through normalized coefficient squares
statement: Let l be prime, Y any scheme, P=P1_Y and W=P times_Y P with the specified DiagonalTraceLocalizations. Fix CompletedRealizations eP and eW and an ordinary completed coefficient square sDelta at the diagonal. Define i:eW(Delta_* completed-unit) isomorphic to Delta_* condensed-unit to be sDelta at the completed regular unit followed by direct image of eP.unitIso. This i satisfies the underlying-sheaf source normalization of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference]. For every f:W to P, completed right-derived model R, normalized acyclic SupportedSource a for f and ordinary coefficient square s for f, there is a condensed NormalizedSource b for the canonical right-derived functor. Mapping a.hom by eP, then the derived square s.derive and the single-object comparison of i, equals eP.singleUnit followed by b.hom. The equality is for the full universal-unit derived square, not an unspecified comparison.

source.place: paragraph (1); initial coefficient and supported-source identification, expanded in lem-diagonal-completed-frame proof

proof.text: Form the supported-source isomorphism explicitly from the ordinary diagonal square and the regular-unit isomorphism. Its underlying-sheaf normalization is proved by cancelling the image of the regular-module underlying isomorphism in the ordinary square normalization.

For f, conjugate the normalized completed supported-source isomorphism by eP.unitIso, the ordinary square at f and the image of i. On underlying sheaves, its inverse is the canonical direct-image composition map, then Delta f=id, then the identity direct-image map.

Evaluate the full universal-unit normalization of s.derive at the single complex of the completed supported source. Naturality of the single-complex comparisons gives the required derived source equation. Exact equivalences preserve the old acyclicity and all the remaining comparison maps are invertible, so the condensed single derived unit is invertible. This supplies b. No trace or integration morphism is used.

theorem completedSupportedCoefficient_transport (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (eP : CompletedRealization l (ProjectiveLine Y))
    (eW : CompletedRealization l (diagonalSurface Y))
    (sΔ : CompletedOrdinarySquare l (diagonalImmersion Y) eP eW) :
    let i := completedSupportedCoefficientIso l Y eP eW sΔ
    ∀ (f : diagonalSurface Y ⟶ ProjectiveLine Y)
      (R : DiagonalRightDerived (diagonalTracePush l f))
      (a : DiagonalTrace.SupportedSource l Y f R)
      (s : CompletedOrdinarySquare l f eW eP),
      let R' := canonicalDiagonalRightDerived
        (CondensedRing.lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]) f)
      ∃ b : DiagonalTrace.NormalizedSource
          (CondensedRing.lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]) f)
          R'
          (source (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]) Y)
          (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj
            (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]) (ProjectiveLine Y)))
          (diagonalImmersion Y ≫ f = 𝟙 _)
          (SupportNormalization (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]) Y f),
        eP.F.mapDerivedCategory.map a.hom ≫
            (s.derive (R := R) (R' := R')).derived.iso.hom.app _ ≫
            R'.R.map
              ((eW.F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app _ ≫
                (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
                  (Modules (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l])
                    (diagonalSurface Y)) 0).map i.hom) =
          eP.singleUnit l (ProjectiveLine Y) ≫ b.hom
